canon_ref.note: The potion burns out after covering roughly fifty miles in minutes; Ryoka collapses and spends two days alone recovering in a cave, inventing [Flashbang] from her [Light] and [Noise] spells, guilt-ridden over Periss.

b2.ryoka_collapses_from_the_haste_potion.summary: The potion's effect burns out after covering fifty miles in minutes; Ryoka collapses and spends two days alone recovering in a cave, inventing a new spell, [Flashbang], from her [Light] and [Noise] cantrips.

canon_ref.note: Back near the Stone Spears camp, Ryoka learns Mrsha vanished that morning with no sound or scent trail; a day-long search of the forest and mountain slopes turns up nothing, and Urksh fears she is dead.

b2.mrsha_vanishes_from_stone_spears_camp.summary: Back near the Stone Spears camp, Ryoka learns Mrsha vanished that morning without any sound or scent trail; a day-long search of the mountain turns up nothing, and Urksh grimly concludes she is likely dead.

canon_ref.note: As a blizzard closes in, Ryoka and Urksh beg the faeries for help; they warn of a steep price tied to fate but agree to lead Ryoka alone toward a chance of finding Mrsha. Urksh equips her with potions, a self-lengthening rope and furs.

b2.frost_fairies_bargain_to_find_mrsha.summary: As a blizzard closes in, Ryoka and Urksh beg the Frost Faeries for help finding Mrsha; the faeries warn of a steep price tied to fate but agree to lead Ryoka alone toward a chance of finding her, and she departs into the storm.

system.name: [Flashbang]
system.note: Combines [Light] and [Noise]; invented during her two days of recovery.
